environment.description: Tomcat 9.0.68 running on EC2 instance in a public subnet. Application is exposed via an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only) on port 443 with TLS termination. PostgreSQL 14 RDS instance in same VPC, security group allows inbound 5432 from application subnet. DB user 'report_svc' has SELECT privilege on all tables in the 'analytics' schema plus pg_catalog. No query-level firewall or parameterization enforcement. The 'filter' parameter is directly concatenated into SQL without any middleware inspection.
